title: Emperamus
summary: Raleigh names Emperamus in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Emperamus, who commanded in the Kings absence, when the slaue brought the newes that opened Era. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XXVII, §. IV, sig. 366a–366b
